subject: Life Skills
title: The Myth of Time Management
description: A fast breakdown of The Myth of Time Management for builders.

hook.text: You cannot manage time. It passes at exactly the same rate for everyone. What you manage is yourself.

buildup.text: Time management books sell millions, but most address symptoms. The real issue is attention and energy, not hours.

discovery.text: You have roughly 16 waking hours daily. The difference between people is not hours but what fills them.

twist.text: Adding more tasks to a packed day does not save time. It fragments attention and lowers quality on everything.

climax.text: Shift the question from 'How do I fit more in?' to 'What deserves my full attention today?'

punchline.text: You do not need more time. You need fewer yeses.

quiz.question: What is the real challenge behind time management?
options: Finding more hours in the day
Managing your attention and energy, not the clock
